taraneh_repository.paper: Aref Farhadipour, Taraneh-ASR: Scaling Persian Speech Recognition and Forced Alignment Across Singing and Conversational Domains (University of Zurich)
taraneh_repository.repo_readme_license_statement: MIT for Taraneh-WBase/WMedium/WLarge; Apache-2.0 for Taraneh-Q0.6B/Q1.7B

contamination_findings.commercial_data_provenance_flag: Weights are MIT/Apache-2.0, but 975.4h of training audio originated from Telegram/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube web scraping — requires standard commercial legal counsel awareness alongside base Whisper pretraining.

taraneh_checkpoints_audited.name: Taraneh-WBase
taraneh_checkpoints_audited.rationale: Lightweight 72.6M Whisper-Base candidate (74.2 MB CT2 INT8) directly comparable in footprint to Shenava-Rizeh v1.0 INT8 (32M, 38.2 MB ONNX INT8).

taraneh_checkpoints_audited.name: Taraneh-WMedium
taraneh_checkpoints_audited.fa_mechanism: PyTorch WhisperForConditionalGeneration decoder cross-attention heads L19/H8 + L16/H12 + medfilt(3) + colnorm_rownorm + DTW + -35dB energy trim (20ms Whisper frame stride)
taraneh_checkpoints_audited.rationale: Primary Taraneh candidate supporting both high-accuracy Persian ASR and cross-attention DTW forced alignment; CT2 INT8 (~764 MB) tests CPU ASR viability while PyTorch CPU tests real asr+fa latency & RAM.

taraneh_checkpoints_audited.name: Taraneh-WLarge
taraneh_checkpoints_audited.rationale: 6.18 GB FP32 (32 decoder layers vs 4 in Turbo); exceeds 8 GB unified memory budget in PyTorch asr+fa mode and already underperforms WMedium slightly on author-reported Media WER (16.06% vs 14.97%) and FarsDat MAE (38.1ms vs 37.8ms).

taraneh_checkpoints_audited.name: Taraneh-Q0.6B
taraneh_checkpoints_audited.rationale: Requires external `qwen_asr` / vLLM runtime (GPU-oriented) or FP32 PyTorch CPU (~2.4+ GB RAM), with worse author-reported Persian WER across every benchmark than Taraneh-WMedium (e.g., PSRB 24.61% vs 19.14%, FarsDat MAE 47.2ms vs 37.8ms).

taraneh_checkpoints_audited.name: Taraneh-Q1.7B
taraneh_checkpoints_audited.rationale: 4.09 GB checkpoint requiring vLLM/PyTorch FP32 on CPU; worse author-reported Persian WER and alignment MAE than Taraneh-WMedium.

persian_alignment_solution_space_audited.approach: CTC Viterbi Forced Alignment on Reza2kn/Shenava-Rizeh v1.0 INT8

persian_alignment_solution_space_audited.status: VERIFIED_UNAVAILABLE (0 Persian/Farsi models in MontrealCorpusTools/mfa-models main tree; Taraneh paper had to train MFA 3.4 in-domain on FarsDat gold phonemic pronunciations)
DEPRIORITIZED (Taraneh Table 3 reports 90.2 ms FarsDat MAE, 2.4x worse than Taraneh-WMedium 37.8 ms, with heavy LLM CPU footprint)
